description: Draft professional summaries from a resume: rule-based drafts built from its title, skills and the bullets that carry a figure, plus AI drafts that use only facts in the resume. Part of the answer is drafted by an AI model (Gemma 4, with Llama 3.3 70B as a backup, on Cloudflare Workers AI) behind ATSPrep's guard, which drops any figure, name or tool the user's text doesn't contain. If the AI part is unavailable, the rule-based part still comes back and ai.message says why.

resume_text.description: The whole resume as plain text, one heading, role or bullet per line.

target_title.description: Optional. The job title the summary should aim at.

name: write_summary
title: Write a resume summary
